dog.description_text:
Meet Freida, a 3-year-old, 60-pound Great Pyrenees with plenty of fluff and love to go around! This sweet, affectionate girl is good with other dogs and loves a good belly rub. And as you can probably tell, she takes being fluffy very seriously!

Freida loves spending time outside, whether she’s exploring or simply enjoying the fresh air, and she’s just as happy heading indoors to get cozy and relax. No matter where she is, Freida is always ready to enjoy the day. This sweet girl is ready to settle in and make herself right at home with her forever family.

Registered adopters interested in Freida can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
